scene: The solved riddle names three transit docks on the tower's open terrace.
picture: A flat side view along a high stone terrace. The player stands centre in lilac headscarf and mustard coat, holding the parchment. Far left sits a river barge canal dock with a wooden gate. Left stands a waiting glass-roofed rail trolley. Right hangs a mountain cable tram beside a metal boarding gantry.
shown: a wooden river barge mooring gate with a bell, on the far left
a glass-roofed trolley waiting empty at a rail platform, on the left
a hanging mountain cable tram cabin parked on an aerial line, on the right
